name: agent-firm-sandbox
//: Mount ONLY the project. Do not mount host home, ~/.ssh, cloud creds, or auth caches.
//runArgs: no-new-privileges hardens. cap-drop=ALL, then additively add ONLY the two caps the egress firewall needs (cap-add wins over cap-drop=ALL in Docker). Uncomment the two cap-add lines + the postStartCommand below to ENABLE the firewall (opt-in — it elevates the container's networking privileges).
//egress: Phase 5 (opt-in): the egress firewall default-denies outbound traffic except an allowlist (npm/PyPI registries, api.anthropic.com, your git host; OpenAI/Codex needs a CDN mitigation — see .devcontainer/egress-allowlist.conf + docs/PHASE5.md). It fails SAFE (refuses to boot open). To enable: uncomment the two --cap-add lines above AND the postStartCommand below. Default-deny egress is the main lever that bounds prompt-injection blast radius.
